messages:
Jo: FYI p99 for /v1/generate jumped from ~1.1s to 2.0s at 11:03. p50 unchanged. No code deploys. Any routing or quota changes?
Noah: I pulled raw rollups. The service-level t-digest merge shows a heavy tail but per-instance histograms indicate it's one proxy path. Looks like origin composition changed.
Rhea: Dashboard currently shows only merged p50/p95/p99 which hides origin mix. Can we make it obvious when a percentile is dominated by a subpopulation?
Diego: We tag samples with `sample_origin` but the rollup pipeline merges t-digests across origins which isn't invertible. Two options: store per-origin t-digests for the last X mins, or keep raw histogram windows to recompute exact percentiles by origin.
Noah: Storing short-term per-origin digests is cheaper and lets us compute exact per-origin percentiles and also the combined percentile by recombining in order. But t-digest merge across many shards still has error. Raw histograms give deterministic recompute.
Jo: For quick triage we need: 1) dashboard legend to show origin percentages for the selected window 2) an "origin breakdown" mode that overlays per-origin percentile lines and shows contribution to p99 as a percentage.
Rhea: UI mock: small stacked bar in the panel header (gateway 70% | proxy-b 20% | fallback 10%) and dashed lines for per-origin p95/p99. Tooltip should say "p99_all = 2.0s; p99_primary = 1.1s (70% traffic); p99_proxy-b = 3.4s (20% traffic)".
Diego: Note: SLOs are measured on p99_all. Any derived view must be labeled "attribution view - not canonical SLO".
Noah: Implementation note: API tweak: `/api/metrics?endpoint=/v1/generate&window=15m&breakdown=origin` returns map origin -> histogram buckets (as arrays). We can recompute percentiles client-side and render.
Jo: Also we should annotate charts with routing-policy events (weight changes, canary start/stop). If people see an overlay "weight: fallback=0.25 at 11:02" they won't panic.
metrics-bot: route-change 2026-03-22T11:02Z: fallback_weight set to 0.25 (id: rc-20260322-5)
Diego: Telemetry task: ensure all proxies set `sample_origin` and preserve across retries/redirects. Integration test: simulate 25% fallback, generate 10k requests, verify recomputed p99 per-origin matches observed per-instance histograms within 2% error.
Rhea: I'll wire a toggle in the panel header: "Attribution mode" with a clear SLO disclaimer. Mock due EOD.
Jo: Noah, can you prototype the origin breakdown API and a small backend job that stores raw histograms for 1h? We can optimize later.
Noah: Yep, will prototype short-window raw histogram retention and the `breakdown=origin` endpoint.
Jo: Great. Let's capture as actions: 1) overlay routing events on charts (Jo) 2) legend origin percentages + dashed per-origin percentiles (Rhea) 3) origin_breakdown API + short raw-hist retention (Noah) 4) telemetry validation + integration test (Diego).
Diego: I'll start a test PR for telemetry checks.
Jo: Sync tomorrow 10:30 to review mocks and API contract. Thanks.
